concept: A website as a plastic model kit, rendered in 3D (Blender). One sprue of ivory plastic on a violet table: an address bar, Home, About and Contact, a picture frame, lines of text, a Book now button, a pointer and a form field, all still on their runners, with the Nexulabs wordmark moulded into the maker's tab. Whole: some assembly required. Close on the top rail, the Book now button cut free and set down: not by you. Then from higher, the page put together and lying on its own empty sprue, the pointer on Book now: we build it. Violet, one ivory plastic, nothing else.
